Design ER model for College Examination and Result Processing. A college conducts examinations for courses offered in a semester. Students register for courses and become eligible to appear in corresponding examinations. Each examination has a date, time, room, and maximum marks. Students receive marks in each examination. Draw the complete ER diagram with keys, cardinalities, and participation constraints.

Each employee works for one department and may work on several projects. Each project is handled for one client and can have many employees. Draw the complete ER diagram with keys, cardinalities, and participation constraints.

Design ER model for Food Delivery Application. A food delivery application connects customers, restaurants, menu items, delivery partners, orders, payments, and reviews. A restaurant offers many menu items. Customers place orders containing items from one restaurant. A delivery partner may deliver many orders, but each delivered order is assigned to one partner. Customers can review restaurants and delivery partners after order completion. Draw the complete ER diagram with keys, cardinalities, and participation constraints.

Design ER model for Hospital Patient and Appointment Management. A hospital stores details of patients, doctors, departments, appointments, medical tests, and prescriptions. Each doctor works in one department, while a department can have many doctors. A patient may book many appointments with different doctors. During an appointment, the doctor may prescribe multiple medicines and may recommend several tests. A prescription must record dosage, frequency, and duration. A test recommendation must record the test date and result when available. Draw the complete ER diagram with keys, cardinalities, and participation constraints.
